confidence_note: Baseline answers carry a verbalized confidence instead of a distribution. ECE, reliability and coverage use it, over parsed answers that state one (n_with_confidence). accuracy is on parsed answers; accuracy_all counts parse failures as wrong and is the number to compare with jevmark runs, which never fail to parse.

latency.note: one call at a time, wall clock of the successful attempt, from the caller's network; rows recorded before retries were counted are treated as retried when slower than the timeout
